'''Rhyder Umatesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3630 BBY]] he was part of the forces brought by the [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] to [[Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhyder Umatesh appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a vendor on Iokath for Imperial-affiliated players.
